review.note: About 160 crops (vegetables, fruit, berries, grains, herbs, flowers, mushrooms) with crates, plus a farm controller, hatch and feeding trough for bees/animals integration. Food and dye only: no metal or ore yields. Built-in support: supported by Productive Trees and Productive Bees; Botany Pots. Influx #31 decides AgriCraft vs Productive Farming.
